procedural_matters: SUI 57071 was represented by Damien Berther.
facts: The video evidence SUI 57071 wishes to present was sought unsuccessfully by SUI 57071 before the hearing.
The video evidence was not available to SUI 57071 at the time of the original hearing.
conclusions: The video evidence that SUI 57071 plans to present is new and might be significant. Therefore, the requirements in RRS 63.7(a)(3) for reopening the hearing are met.
